card.title: Helpful Culprit
card.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent lead. I'll test the machine. It may be dispensing something harmful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made that coffee yourself. With six sugars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll prepare six-sugar samples for comparison. We may be dealing with a plant that couldn't handle hospitality.

heightening.evidence: B4 removes machine-only blame, so A5 changes to a plant-tolerance hypothesis while appearing industrious.
